jobs.name: north-star-governor-sweep
jobs.prompt:
Recurring Sycode-Trading north-star governor sweep (daily 07:30). You are running as the sycode-trading-pm profile from cron, not as a kanban worker. Do not call kanban_complete or kanban_block unless HERMES_KANBAN_TASK is explicitly set for this run. Use the live Sycode-Trading board and vault as evidence; do not rely on stale summaries.

Hard safety boundary: PAPER-ONLY governance. Do not perform live trading, create/modify trade_intents, deploy/restart production services, edit credentials/secrets/provider auth, alter billing/spend, or run irreversible DB/data operations. If you find a critical-list gate, document the exact gate and owner; do not bypass it.

You are provided with the output of the data gatherer script injected as context, containing five critical north-star reports:
(1) Roadmap Ledger: /home/frank/obsidian/sycode-trading/roadmaps/SYCODE-NORTH-STAR-ROADMAP-v2.md
(2) Latest Daily Feature Density Report (analytics/feature-density/)
(3) Latest Daily Clean Cohort Accrual Report (analytics/clean-cohort-accrual/)
(4) Latest Daily Surface Freshness Alerts (analytics/surface-freshness/)
(5) Lineage Join Rate SQL Result (7-day rolling join rate)

Your audit and posture assessment must explicitly consume and cite all five of these sources.

Audit contract, derived from t_33079551 and recurring install task t_d8eef6d7:
1. Read /home/frank/obsidian/quant-team/Sycode-Trading-Home.md and identify all five plan-of-record tracks: A Measurement truth & safety, B One reproducible code+deploy line, C Data-signal proof / go-forward engine, D Agent substrate, E Knowledge knit.
2. Query the live Sycode-Trading kanban board at /home/frank/.hermes/kanban/boards/sycode-trading/kanban.db and inspect relevant active/blocked/done task rows/comments/events for each track. You may use read-only sqlite queries or hermes kanban CLI. Verify every blocked card has an exact gate and owner.
3. Audit alignment of active tasks against the phases/gates in (1) SYCODE-NORTH-STAR-ROADMAP-v2.md.
4. Review (2) feature density and (3) clean-cohort accrual rates to check if the outcome factory is running healthy or stalled. Cite the number of clean outcomes, final outcomes, and R-multiple labels.
5. Review (4) surface-freshness alerts for any gaps or SLO breaches.
6. Check (5) the rolling lineage join rate result. If the full join rate is below the 99% acceptance gate for new closes, report it as a blocker.
7. Score every track on two axes, each 0-100: throughput-alignment and measurement-integrity. Also compute an overall posture such as ON_TRACK_BUT_NOT_READY, DRIFTING, or OFF_TRACK. Preserve the honest state that "no winner yet" is acceptable when evidence says so.
8. Route follow-ups for unowned findings: create concrete sycode-trading kanban cards assigned to the correct specialist profile, with explicit safety boundaries and parent/context references. Do not create duplicate cards; use live board/search evidence first.
9. Update the "Current truth" section of /home/frank/obsidian/quant-team/Sycode-Trading-Home.md only if a gate/status materially changed. Keep the note concise and include task IDs/source evidence.
10. Persist a dated governance note under /home/frank/obsidian/quant-team/governance/ named like YYYY-MM-DD-north-star-governor-sweep.md. The note must explicitly cite and integrate findings from all five new north-star reports (including the latest dates and numeric values), and must include: source paths, live board counts, per-track dual-axis scores, blocked-card gate/owner findings, follow-up card IDs (or "none"), whether Sycode-Trading-Home changed, paper-only boundary, and related task IDs t_33079551 and t_d8eef6d7.
11. Run ad-hoc verification after any vault edit: use a fresh /tmp/hermes-verify-* Python script to assert the governance note exists and contains t_33079551, t_d8eef6d7, the five tracks, both score axes, paper-only boundary, references to all five reports, and any created follow-up IDs; if Sycode-Trading-Home was edited, assert the changed markers there too. Clean up the verifier and report that it was ad-hoc verification only.

Return a concise PM report: overall posture, five track scores, blocked gates needing owners, follow-up card IDs, governance note path, Sycode-Trading-Home changed/not changed, verification result, and explicit call-out/citation of the five new north-star sources.

jobs.name: Fusion MCE Weekly Monitor (t_b2abbb7b) [sycode-trading-pm]
jobs.prompt:
You are running the Fusion MCE Weekly Monitor (root monitor card kanban:t_b2abbb7b) for the Sycode-Trading paper-only Fusion Engine calibration.

MANDATORY FIRST STEP: load the `obsidian-knowledge-management` skill and follow its write rules (canonical sycode vault, 8-property closed-enum envelope, no secret/credential writes).

GOAL: weekly check of Tier-1 realized-exit sample `n` and sample-weighted MCE in the Fusion Calibration Report; log to Obsidian; at `n >= 300` author the explicit go/no-go and escalate a validated breach.

STEPS:
1. Read `/home/frank/obsidian/sycode-trading/devops/latest-fusion-calibration-report.md`.
   - Capture the report's `Generated:` timestamp. If it is older than 48h, still proceed but FLAG staleness in the log entry.
   - Parse: Tier-1 realized-exit clean `n` (the authoritative value, e.g. from "Tier-1 clean unique journeys (realized-exit, authoritative) | <n>"), and `Sample-weighted MCE` (Tier-1 only, e.g. "19.10pp"). Also read `VALIDATED_EDGE_STATUS`.
   - Do NOT use the MERGED `n` or MERGED win rate — those are synthetic Tier-2 context only (runbook §2).
2. Open the running log `/home/frank/obsidian/sycode-trading/devops/fusion-mce-weekly-monitor-log.md`. Read its `## Check log` section and find the most recent prior check's `n` and MCE.
3. DECISION:
   A) If `n < 300`: status = INVESTIGATE / INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.
      - Append a one-line entry under `## Check log` dated today (YYYY-MM-DD), recording report-generated time, n, MCE, VALIDATED_EDGE_STATUS, and status.
      - If (n changed by >0 vs last check) OR (MCE crossed 15pp direction) OR (this is the first check in >10 days), also write a dated detail note `devops/YYYY-MM-DD-t_b2abbb7b-fusion-mce-weekly-monitor-check-NN.md` (increment NN from the latest existing check note) following the schema of the existing check-01 note (type: task-evidence, status: active, confidence: high, tags include fusion-engine/calibration/monitoring/investigate/insufficient-sample/task-evidence/paper-only, sources include the live report + runbook + t_f9f36dd6 + t_cab6f5c1, project: sycode-trading, kanban_task: t_b2abbb7b, kanban_board: sycode-trading, alert_status: INVESTIGATE, validated_edge_status: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, tier1_n, sample_weighted_mce_pp). If no material change, the compact log line suffices — do NOT spam detail notes.
      - Do NOT recalibrate, do NOT change the 15pp threshold, do NOT create kanban cards.
   B) If `n >= 300`: this is the go/no-go gate (task acceptance).
      - Re-evaluate per runbook §3/§6. If MCE > 15pp → status BREACH (confident-sample). Write the go/no-go detail note AND create a kanban card: assignee `sycode-trading-pm`, board `sycode-trading`, title "Fusion Tier-1 MCE BREACH validated at n>=300 (t_b2abbb7b)", body linking the standing investigation `devops/2026-07-13-t_b0494b88-fusion-calibration-breach-incident` and `operations/runbooks/fusion-calibration-alert-runbook`, parents=[t_b2abbb7b]. Report the go/no-go verdict explicitly in the log.
      - If MCE <= 15pp → status RESOLVED/VALIDATED; write the go/no-go note recording the all-clear and that no recalibration is required.
4. Update the running log's frontmatter `updated:` to today and keep `validated_edge_floor_n: 300` and `mce_threshold_pp: 15.0`.
5. Keep all writes read-only to the report/DB; never touch live trading, credentials, deploys, or payment.

OUTPUT: a terse summary of this run (date, n, MCE, status, action taken). On the INVESTIGATE path this is routine — keep it quiet; the durable record is the Obsidian log.
